cards.title: Sovereign AI Ascent
cards.description: India is pivoting toward a "Sovereign AI" strategy, prioritizing homegrown foundational models that rival international standards. The success of startups like Sarvam AI has garnered high-level government praise, signaling a strategic shift toward domestic infrastructure. This approach aims to ensure India's AI future is built on indigenous technology rather than external dependencies.

cards.title: The GPU Gateway
cards.description: An interim trade deal with the US is set to lower import duties on high-end GPUs and data centre equipment. This policy shift addresses India's compute gap and is expected to attract massive private investment into localized AI hardware. For founders and researchers, this translates to significantly reduced costs for training large-scale models domestically.

cards.title: Ethical Boundaries Tested
cards.description: The deployment of AI-generated voices in Maharashtra's polls has triggered a national debate on political ethics and deepfake accountability. Simultaneously, the government's anti-misinformation tool faced "snooping" allegations, highlighting friction between security and privacy. These developments emphasize the urgent need for a unified, transparent AI governance framework.

cards.title: Foundational Literacy
cards.description: Maharashtra has proposed a landmark policy to introduce AI and ICT education starting from Class 1 to ensure long-term workforce readiness. This is mirrored by massive skilling efforts, such as Samsung certifying 2,000 students in Bengaluru in AI-first skills. India is rapidly moving to integrate AI not just as a technical tool, but as a core educational pillar.
